name: Reapermon

rulings.question: Can this card’s [Opponent's Turn] effect ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) an opponent’s Digimon when it unsuspends during my opponent’s unsuspend phase?

rulings.answer: Yes, you choose one of those Digimon to ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.).
rulings.question: During my opponent’s unsuspend phase, more than one of my opponent's Digimon become unsuspended. Do I choose which Digimon to ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) with this card’s [Opponent's Turn] effect?

When an opponent’s Digimon becomes unsuspended, can I choose not to activate this card’s [Opponent's Turn] effect to ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) that Digimon in order to preserve the effect’s [Once Per Turn] limit?

rulings.answer: No, you can't.  ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) activates even if the opponent's Digimon that becomes unsuspended is level 3 or has no digivolution cards.
rulings.question: My opponent unsuspends a Digimon that has no digivolution cards or is level 3. Can I choose not to activate the ＜De-Digivolve  nocategory＞ (Trash up to nocategory cards from the top. You can't trash past level 3 cards.) from this card’s [Opponent's Turn] effect?
